```{r }
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(stringr)
library(patchwork)
library(plotly)
```

```{r }
access_walk  <- readRDS("D:/Final-Project/DATA/access_walk_clean.rds")
access_cycle <- readRDS("D:/Final-Project/DATA/access_cycle_clean.rds")

saps_active <- read_csv("D:/Final-Project/data/SAPS_2022_Small_Area_UR_171024.csv") %>%
  filter(T1_1AGETT <= 950) %>%
  mutate(
    SA_PUB2022  = as.character(GEOGID),
    denom       = T11_1_TSCCC - T11_1_WMFHSCCC - T11_1_NSSCCC,
    perc_active = ifelse(denom > 0,
                         100 * (T11_1_FSCCC + T11_1_BISCCC) / denom,
                         NA_real_)
  ) %>%
  select(SA_PUB2022, perc_active)

urb_rural <- read_csv("D:/Final-Project/data/SAPS_2022_Small_Area_UR_171024.csv") %>%
  mutate(
    category    = str_extract(UR_Category_Desc, "(?<=\\.).*"),
    urban_rural = case_when(
      category %in% c(" Cities", " Satellite Urban Towns", " Independent urban towns") ~ "Urban",
      category %in% c(" Rural areas with high urban influence",
                      " Rural areas with moderate urban influence",
                      " Highly rural/remote areas") ~ "Rural",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    SA_PUB2022 = as.character(GEOGID)
  ) %>%
  select(SA_PUB2022, urban_rural) %>%
  distinct()

cat("Walk rows:", nrow(access_walk), "\n")
cat("Cycle rows:", nrow(access_cycle), "\n")
```

```{r filter-urban}
urban_csas <- urb_rural %>%
  filter(urban_rural == "Urban") %>%
  pull(SA_PUB2022)

access_walk_urban <- access_walk %>%
  mutate(SA_PUB2022 = as.character(id)) %>%
  filter(SA_PUB2022 %in% urban_csas)

access_cycle_urban <- access_cycle %>%
  mutate(SA_PUB2022 = as.character(id)) %>%
  filter(SA_PUB2022 %in% urban_csas)

cat("Urban walk rows:", nrow(access_walk_urban), "\n")
cat("Urban cycle rows:", nrow(access_cycle_urban), "\n")
```

```{r boxplots-raw, fig.width=10, fig.height=5}
# Raw scale
p_walk_raw <- access_walk_urban %>%
  filter(accessibility > 0) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = factor(cutoff), y = accessibility)) +
  geom_boxplot(fill = "steelblue") +
  labs(
    title = "Walking accessibility - Raw",
    x = "Cutoff (minutes)",
    y = "School places reachable"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

p_cycle_raw <- access_cycle_urban %>%
  filter(accessibility > 0) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = factor(cutoff), y = accessibility)) +
  geom_boxplot(fill = "darkorange") +
  labs(
    title = "Cycling accessibility - Raw",
    x = "Cutoff (minutes)",
    y = "School places reachable"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

p_walk_raw + p_cycle_raw
```

```{r boxplots-normalised, fig.width=10, fig.height=5}
# Log normalised
p_walk_norm <- access_walk_urban %>%
  filter(accessibility > 0) %>%
  mutate(accessibility_log = log1p(accessibility)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = factor(cutoff), y = accessibility_log)) +
  geom_boxplot(fill = "steelblue") +
  labs(
    title = "Walking accessibility - Log normalised",
    x = "Cutoff (minutes)",
    y = "School places reachable (log1p)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

p_cycle_norm <- access_cycle_urban %>%
  filter(accessibility > 0) %>%
  mutate(accessibility_log = log1p(accessibility)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = factor(cutoff), y = accessibility_log)) +
  geom_boxplot(fill = "darkorange") +
  labs(
    title = "Cycling accessibility - Log normalised",
    x = "Cutoff (minutes)",
    y = "School places reachable (log1p)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

p_walk_norm + p_cycle_norm
```

```{r scatter-walk-raw}
scatter_walk_raw <- access_walk_urban %>%
  filter(cutoff == 30) %>%
  left_join(saps_active, by = "SA_PUB2022") %>%
  filter(!is.na(perc_active), accessibility > 0)

plot_ly(scatter_walk_raw,
        x = ~accessibility,
        y = ~perc_active,
        type = "scatter",
        mode = "markers",
        marker = list(opacity = 0.5, size = 5, color = "#a80050"),
        text = ~paste("CSA:", SA_PUB2022,
                      "<br>Accessibility:", round(accessibility),
                      "<br>Active travel:", round(perc_active, 1), "%"),
        hoverinfo = "text") %>%
  layout(
    title = "Walking vs Active travel - Raw (30 min)",
    xaxis = list(title = "School places reachable"),
    yaxis = list(title = "% walking or cycling to school")
  )
```

```{r scatter-walk-normalised}
scatter_walk_norm <- access_walk_urban %>%
  filter(cutoff == 30) %>%

  )
```
